measurements.name: linear dispersion peak wavelength
measurements.method: argmax of σ(k), the larger eigenvalue of J − k²D, at Du, Dv
measurements.reference_source: slot scale 60 µm; Turing 1952 dispersion; Schnakenberg 1979 Jacobian
measurements.note: linear peak is deliberately a few micrometres off 60 so the equilibrated lattice, not the onset mode, carries the slot scale

measurements.name: equilibrated activator FFT wavelength
measurements.method: parabolic interpolation of the radial power spectrum of u on the 480 µm periodic patch
measurements.reference_source: detail scale 6e-05 m assigned to this Holocene epithelial patch

measurements.name: dispersion-peak versus equilibrated wavelength Pearson r
measurements.method: corr(λ_linear(s), λ_FFT(s)) across diffusivity scales s in {0.35, 0.55, 0.80, 1, 1.4, 2, 3}
measurements.reference_source: goodness-of-fit gate for the Turing wavenumber law

measurements.name: wavelength sweep RMSE
measurements.method: root mean square of λ_FFT − λ_linear across the diffusivity sweep
measurements.reference_source: zero residual would mean the nonlinear lattice sits on the linear peak
measurements.note: a nonzero RMSE is the nonlinear shift above onset, not a missing sweep

measurements.name: wavelength sweep KS statistic
measurements.method: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic between linear and FFT wavelength samples

measurements.name: equal-diffusion ablation amplitude
measurements.method: same integrator with Du = Dv = DU_UM2; Turing trace gap is negative
measurements.reference_source: Turing 1952: equal diffusivities cannot destabilise a stable Jacobian

measurements.name: 10 µm predecessor-scale amplitude
measurements.method: same Du, Dv on a periodic patch of length 10 µm (below one wavelength)
measurements.reference_source: scale ladder at 0 Ma: the reference is the 480 µm Turing amplitude, not a copy of the quenched value
measurements.note: chronoseries is 1/1, so the predecessor is a scale, not an older species

measurements.name: specimen USNM E39365 foreground fraction
measurements.method: pixels with luminance > 0.18 on the CC0 plate, opened and hole-filled
measurements.reference_source: USNM E39365 aboral photographs; black museum ground, three tests
measurements.note: reference 0.70 is a single-test fill prior; the plate holds three tests, so the fraction is lower

measurements.name: specimen union-mask circularity
measurements.method: circularity of the union of all bright tests, not of one individual
measurements.reference_source: a single disc would be near 1; three separate tests on one plate are not

measurements.name: specimen structure-tensor coherency
measurements.method: mean (λ1−λ2)/(λ1+λ2) of the Sobel structure tensor inside the foreground
measurements.reference_source: spine canopy is locally oriented, so coherency exceeds an isotropic noise prior of 0.25

measurements.name: ocellus nearest-neighbour spacing
measurements.method: periodic nearest-neighbour distance of activator peaks above mean + 0.45 std
measurements.reference_source: FFT wavelength is the row period; nearest neighbours of a spot lattice need not equal it
measurements.note: spacing CV = 0.3298; n_peaks = 71; one-period peak window

measurements.name: ocellus spacing KS against FFT wavelength
measurements.method: one-sample KS of nearest-neighbour spacings against Normal(λ_FFT, s)
measurements.reference_source: the FFT wavelength is the null centre; D = 0 would mean the spacings are that normal

measurements.name: ocellus spacing coefficient of variation
measurements.method: std(nearest neighbour) / mean(nearest neighbour) on the periodic patch
measurements.reference_source: a perfectly regular lattice would have CV 0

measurements.name: specimen per-disc circularity
measurements.method: mean circularity of connected components after a 15 px closing of the spine fringe; components under 5000 px dropped
measurements.reference_source: USNM E39365; the reference is the union-mask circularity, which mixes three tests

measurements.name: specimen per-disc aspect ratio
measurements.method: mean bounding-box aspect of the same closed components
measurements.reference_source: USNM E39365; the reference is the union bounding box, which is wider than one test
